_why: This package is NOT a Statamic addon and is deliberately not listed on the Statamic
Marketplace. It is a plain Composer library published on Packagist: it requires no
statamic/cms, contains zero references to any Statamic class (verified: `grep -r Statamic
src/ config/ tests/` is empty), and has no Control Panel surface. It exists so that the
Statamic addons which DO depend on it (statamic-activity, statamic-notifications,
preference-center) never have to reference a concrete App\Models\User.
addon-lint therefore runs here only as a general PHP-package hygiene check. The four rules
below encode 'this is a Statamic addon' as an assumption. They are disabled with reasons,
not because the findings are wrong, but because the premise does not hold for this package.
Decision by Adrian Goldner, 2026-08-01: ship on Packagist as a library, no Marketplace listing.
If this package ever grows a Statamic-facing surface, re-enable all four rules before the
next tag — every one of them would then be a genuine defect.

reasons.structure.composer-type: `type: library` is correct. `statamic-addon` would make Statamic list a package in the CP addon overview that offers the user no capability, no screen and no setting.
reasons.structure.statamic-metadata: `extra.statamic` was removed on purpose (2026-08-01). Its only consumers are the CP addon card and the Marketplace listing, and this package appears in neither. Declaring it would advertise an addon that does not exist.
reasons.bootstrap.addon-service-provider: `Statamic\Providers\AddonServiceProvider` cannot be extended without requiring statamic/cms. The package must boot in a plain Laravel application (it is a Laravel library first), and it uses none of what AddonServiceProvider supplies: no routes, no views, no fieldtypes, no Vite.
reasons.testing.addon-testcase: `Statamic\Testing\AddonTestCase` lives in statamic/cms, which is not a dependency. The suite boots on Orchestra Testbench, which is the correct harness for a Laravel library and is what actually covers the supported laravel/framework range.
